summary: Extended agentd support bundle projection with runtime loop, recovery, ecosystem and offline snapshot status while keeping agentd read-only and resolver-free.
acceptance_evidence: SupportBundleProjection now contains runtime, recovery and ecosystem sections.
Runtime projection reports loop status, latest run, event counts, unresolved effects, rollback pending count and fixed no-shell/no-direct-model-execution invariants.
Recovery projection reports recovery counts, unresolved effects, human review requirement and run-store+audit-journal as source of truth.

Ecosystem projection reports registry snapshot hash, expires_at, freshness, pinned-local status, lockfile, active set hash, active artifact coordinates, replay status, revocation state and offline baseline status.
Support bundle tests assert normal_shell_available=false, model_output_direct_execution_allowed=false, model_replay_authority=false, agentd_resolver_logic=false and network_required=false.
Secret-like raw content and private key paths are excluded from support bundle projections.

commands.summary: Functional capability replay passed and included support bundle regression coverage.
agent_core 107, agentd 59, runtime_contracts 27 and security_execution 79 tests passed; doctests passed.

blocked_shortcuts: agentd does not own ecosystem resolver logic.
Support bundle is read-only projection, not activation authority.
Raw secrets and private key paths are not included.
Model replay is not recovery authority.
promotion_impact: Production support evidence can now explain Agent Runtime health and ecosystem state without leaking secrets or expanding agentd ownership.
